snippet.title: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition - Enhanced Trailer
snippet.description:
Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War - Definitive Edition will release on August 14th 2025 at US $29.99. As a thank-you to our loyal fans, players who already own Dawn of War - Anniversary Edition will receive a 30% discount on the Definitive Edition. 

To celebrate, we’ve enhanced the original Dawn of War trailer in 4K—a perfect way to relive the glory and prepare to serve...again.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3556750/Warhammer_40000_Dawn_of_War__Definitive_Edition/
